context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 116 tested the hybrid referral + sales tracking system. Key findings: (1) sales-stats endpoint returns paidCustomers, totalEarnings, pendingEarnings, paidOutEarnings, commissionRate=0.20. (2) admin/sales-overview returns full data including totalRevenue, totalCommission, partners list with per-partner breakdown. (3) Backward compatibility maintained - my-link and stats endpoints work unchanged. (4) Fraud prevention works - self-referral rejected, same email/phone checks in place. (5) Commission recording function correctly calculates 20% commission, stores with status=pending, prevents duplicates, skips zero-amount invoices and non-referred users. (6) Invoice router correctly wired to call referral_commission_recorder when invoice becomes fully paid.
